## Workspace dependencies

[`nsh-base`](/crates/nsh-base/), [`nsh-core`](/crates/nsh-core/), [`nsh-dev`](/crates/nsh-dev/), [`nsh-engine`](/crates/nsh-engine/), [`nsh-testing`](/crates/nsh-testing/). It also uses 9 crates from outside the workspace.

## Features

`crypto`, `default`, `dev`, `editor`, `emoji-picker`, `highlight`, `js`, `math`, `plot`, `rich-editor`, `shader`, `svg`, `term`, `updater`, `websocket`, `zlib`

## Build

Run this from the repository root.

```bash
cargo build --release -p nsh-platform-android
```
